title: Exact Evaluation of cos(11*pi/12) via the Cosine Sum Formula
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate \cos(11\pi/12) exactly by expressing it as \cos(\pi/4 + 2\pi/3).

steps.title: Apply the Cosine Addition Formula
steps.explanation: Expand cos(pi/4 + 2*pi/3) using cos(A + B) = cos A cos B - sin A sin B.

steps.title: Substitute Exact Special-Angle Values
steps.explanation: Use cos(pi/4) = sin(pi/4) = sqrt(2)/2, cos(2*pi/3) = -1/2, and sin(2*pi/3) = sqrt(3)/2.
steps.why: In Quadrant II, 2*pi/3 has reference angle pi/3 with negative cosine and positive sine.

steps.title: Combine Fractions
steps.explanation: Combine the numerators over the common denominator 4.
steps.why: 11*pi/12 lies in Quadrant II, where cosine is negative.
